# Trinqa

> Trinqa is a self-driving portfolio that keeps money ready when users need it and puts eligible idle funds to work when they do not.

Trinqa is not positioned as a crypto wallet, exchange, bank account, or trading platform.

Users define risk preference, time horizon, liquidity needs, and intent. Trinqa coordinates supported portfolio strategies, liquidity, and money movement in the background.

The product experience is centered on:
- total portfolio
- ready-to-use liquidity
- growing balance
- strategy
- risk
- time horizon
- earnings
- portfolio activity

Blockchain, Stellar, anchors, DeFi protocols, swaps, and settlement infrastructure are implementation rails rather than the primary product identity.

Returns are not guaranteed.
